content.title: AVT Q3 CY2025 Deep Dive: Asia and Farnell Drive Growth Amid Margin Pressures
content.summary: Electronic components distributor Avnet (NASDAQGS:AVT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 5.3% year on year to $5.90 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $6 billion at the midpoint, 2.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.84 per share was 4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
